name: floating-personal-gantt
description: Aplicación de escritorio ultra-ligera y moderna para Windows con diagrama de Gantt flotante, modo Click-Through, mini-widget HUD y persistencia desacoplada.

scripts.clean: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist-electron', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.package:win: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win

author: Floating Personal Gantt Contributors
